title: Hedging, stance and inference
source: Language Learning Hub · original V4.4 teaching draft, not an external textbook
goal: Apply hedging, stance and inference in an original academic-English context and explain reasoning in coherent English
context: 为研究解读选择适量限定语，既明确判断又保留证据边界。
grammar: epistemic may/could 表示认识上的可能，不是许可或能力。apparently 表表面信息，arguably 提出可争论判断。hedging 应指出不确定的具体位置，而不是给所有词都加 perhaps。
common_mistake: ‘It might possibly perhaps…’多重堆叠通常不如一个明确限定。

reading: The lower error rate suggests that the revised instructions may be easier to follow. However, the participants also received more time to complete the task. The improvement could therefore reflect either change or their combination. It is reasonable to favour the revision provisionally, while testing the timing effect separately. This position is cautious without being empty. It states what the evidence supports, identifies an alternative explanation and proposes a way to reduce the uncertainty.
